wizard.blankDesc: Start from scratch with the step-by-step wizard
wizard.templateForbidden: This template is not available for your account.
wizard.guideIntro: The CNAO template is reserved for specific use. You can create your own survey by following these steps:
wizard.guideStep1: Choose « Blank survey » to start the step-by-step wizard.
wizard.guideStep2: Enter a title and description to give context to your survey.
wizard.guideStep3: Add your questions (single choice, multiple choice, rating, number, or free text).
wizard.guideStep4: Mark important questions with the « Required » badge when an answer is mandatory.
wizard.guideStep5: Preview, save as draft if needed, then publish and share the code or link.
wizard.editPublishedNote: The share code and link stay the same. Avoid deleting questions that already have answers — existing responses are linked to them.
